```{r}
library(cowplot)
library(httpgd)
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
library(fs)
library(yardstick)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(vroom)


# final methods for all euk genome simulation

# using the genbank taxid mapping for exhaustive most accurate species - accession mapping.
genbank_taxid_acc_mapping <- vroom("archive/eukaryotic_genomes.tsv") %>% 
    select(species = `Organism Name`, everything()) %>%
    mutate(
        species = str_replace_all(species, "[^[:alnum:]]+", "_"), # removes all nonalphanumeric
        species = str_remove_all(species, "^_+|_+$"), # removes trailing or leading underscore
        species = tolower(species)
    ) %>%
    group_by(species) %>%
    slice_max(order_by = coalesce(str_detect(`Assembly Accession`, "GCF"), FALSE),n = 1,with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(species = str_replace_all(species, "_", " "))


# getting the genomes in eukdetect2 db
all_eukdetect_genomes <- 
vroom("/storage/project/r-alind6-0/shared/data_swap/johnathan/eukdb_v5/busco_taxid_genome_link.txt", col_names = c("busco", "taxid", "species")) %>%
    select(-busco) %>% 
    filter(!is.na(species)) %>%
    distinct(species, taxid) %>%
    mutate(
        species = str_replace_all(species, "[^[:alnum:]]+", "_"),
        species = str_remove_all(species, "^_+|_+$"),
        species = tolower(species)
    ) %>%
    select(eukdetect_db_species = species, taxid) %>%
    mutate(eukdetect_db_species = str_replace_all(eukdetect_db_species, "_", " "))

# merging based on taxid
merged_genbank_eukdetect2 <- all_eukdetect_genomes %>% 
    semi_join(genbank_taxid_acc_mapping, by = c("taxid" = "Organism Taxonomic ID")) %>%
    left_join(genbank_taxid_acc_mapping, by = c("taxid" = "Organism Taxonomic ID")) %>%
    select(eukdetect_db_species, taxid, species, acc = `Assembly Accession`)


ls_df <- 
    vroom("/storage/home/hcoda1/1/jshih41/scratch/final_eukdetect2_sims/simulation_runs/sim_all_euk_genome_mixtures/euk_ls.txt", col_names = "full_acc", delim = "\t") %>%
        mutate(acc = str_extract(full_acc, "^[^_]*_[^_]*")) %>%
        mutate(full_acc = str_replace(full_acc, ".fna", "")) %>%
        distinct(acc, .keep_all = TRUE)


all_euk_genome_mapping_final <- merged_genbank_eukdetect2 %>%
    select(species = eukdetect_db_species, taxid, acc) %>%
    distinct(acc, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    filter(!is.na(acc)) %>%
    left_join(ls_df, by = "acc")

# time to assign a mixture and a simulated coverage
set.seed(123)
all_euk_genome_mapping_final %>%
    slice_sample(prop = 1) %>% # shuffles
    mutate(mix_id = ceiling(row_number() / 10)) %>%
    group_by(mix_id) %>%
    mutate(
        sim_fcov = exp(runif(n(), log(1e-3), log(1))),
        normalized_fcov = sim_fcov / sum(sim_fcov)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    write_csv("all_euk_genome_mapping.csv")


# simulated coverages are being simualted at a log uniform distirbution from 0.001 to 1.
vroom("simulation_runs/sim_all_euk_genome_mixtures/all_euk_genome_mapping.csv") %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = sim_fcov)) + 
        geom_histogram(bins = 100) +
        scale_x_log10()



```
